content.short: Stably helps institutions launch branded stablecoins and advises on reserves, liquidity and distribution.
content.description: Stably has been in stablecoins since 2018, when it launched one of the first dollar backed tokens, and now spends most of its time helping other institutions do the same. The issuance product, run with Brale, covers multi-chain deployment, on and off ramps and reserve attestation, which gets a branded token live in days rather than quarters. Separately it advises on the parts that decide whether a stablecoin survives contact with the market, meaning peg stability, liquidity depth, DeFi integration and distribution. The company is based in Seattle.
